answer.text: Maintaining a short position in the underlying stock proportional to the delta of the convertible

explanation.text: The Logic: Delta hedging keeps the portfolio delta-neutral by shorting the underlying proportional to the convertible's delta. The Trap: Other actions don't achieve delta-neutrality. Cross-Exam Context: Core convertible arb technique. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Re-hedge dynamically as stock price moves — static hedging fails quickly.
